scope.purpose: Input and split definitions for validation of the standalone three-module evaluation on KiTS23 and MMWHS.

hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True); payload hashes exclude their containing identifiers.

protocol.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only to the training fold

classifier.other_parameters: Remaining parameters use scikit-learn 1.2.2 defaults in the validated environment.

protocol.aggregation: Mean fold balanced accuracy per directed spacing pair, then mean of the six off-diagonal directions.

canonical_record_schema.organ_volumes: integer voxel counts keyed by organ ID strings

acquisition_robustness.boundary: These plans reproduce the completed current panel assignments. They are recorded definitions and are not enforced by the runner.

protocol.group_key: source_case_id, falling back to patient_id then sample_id in the existing implementation
protocol.group_boundary: Recorded source-case disjointness; identical bare patient numbers across CT and MR do not establish cross-modal patient identity.
protocol.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only to support features

classifier.other_parameters: Remaining parameters use scikit-learn 1.2.2 defaults in the validated environment.

protocol.centroid: Nearest class centroid after support-fitted scaling

seed_42.membership_status: Current sampler reconstruction matches independently saved control assignments; original main assignments were not recorded.

seed_123.membership_status: Current sampler reconstruction matches independently saved control assignments; original main assignments were not recorded.

seed_456.membership_status: Current sampler reconstruction matches independently saved control assignments; original main assignments were not recorded.

anatomical_generalization.boundary: Support/query identity is verified against later saved controls, not the missing original main split records. The runner does not consume these plans.

plans.organ_label_rule: sample_id.rsplit(":", 1)[1], verified against normalized manifest primary_organ for every sample

algorithm.ordered_membership: Normalize manifest without reordering; filter by modality, supported organ and available feature ID; concatenate lexicographically sorted organ blocks while preserving manifest order inside each block.
algorithm.balancing: Minimum stratum size is20 in every organ/modality; no query/target cap reduces it. Current _sample_records returns the full stratum unchanged and consumes no RNG draws.
algorithm.relevance: Candidate primary_organ equals query primary_organ; no same-patient exclusion is added.
algorithm.metrics: L2-normalized cosine similarity, NumPy argsort of negative similarities, AP over all same-organ positives, Top1/Top5 any-positive hits, direction-balanced mean.
algorithm.tie_policy: Existing NumPy argsort behavior is preserved; no ID-based tie-breaking or numeric rounding is introduced.
algorithm.bootstrap: Pool plan is shared; bootstrap randomness and numeric backend remain distinct execution parameters and are not frozen by this plan.

cross_modal_alignment.boundary: Ordered pools were reconstructed from the manifest and current evaluator. Pool verification does not establish score identity across numerical backends.

replay_environment.scope: Current CPU saved-feature replay only; distinct from historical runtime and the fresh GPU panel.
replay_environment.threads: Replay experiments controlled BLAS threads explicitly; use consistent numerical settings when comparing runs.

limitations: Recorded plans are not enforced runtime inputs.
Historical metric discrepancies remain unresolved; this release does not certify identical published scores.
Frozen-encoder assessment is distinct from pretraining or downstream-training reproduction.
